name: C4 Factory Session client
description: Installs c4session and, while the devcontainer runs, registers it as a Session on its Container in C4 Factory.

binaryUrl.description: URL of a linux c4session binary; ${arch} becomes amd64 or arm64. Its directory must also serve SHA256SUMS, which the download is checked against. Empty: go install it when Go is present.

version.description: Module version for go install, when binaryUrl is empty.

summary.description: One line about the work, shown on the Session.
